posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
We've done several live streams of Sentinels of the Multiverse over on our Twitch channel, and it's going to be a weekly thing for the foreseeable future. The stream includes strategy discussions to help viewers learn more about how to play SotM, and we also chat a bit about new things!

You can access all of the archived streams on YouTube & Twitch via our Streams page.

We stream every Tuesday at 7 pm Eastern time. Follow us on Twitch to get notified. We might reveal some interesting tidbits, and you'll be sure to learn a thing or two. We do try to keep an eye on the chat room to take your strategy thoughts and questions into account.

In the future we would like to bring on more special guests, whether from regular viewers, the forums, or elsewhere. Watch the streams and participate and you may get to be on the show one week!

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
I won the GI Bunker/AZ/RC Wraith.

 

It was great draws by the heroes and consistent luck having a non-drone to put on top with Eyepiece.

Bunker got going super fast, rocked Gatling-armor-Recharge for a while, then went Upgrade to turret with Gatling/armor/Omni/Ammo Drop/Flak.

Wraith was clearing his deck, alternating with razor+2 when I could get away without a second Eyepiece.

AZ started off great with 2 frost drains and Transducer, which was big for clearing the components at start, Ended up getting ridiculously built up due to Wraith burying destruction cards and drones.

 

It was a perfect storm of starting hands, some card luck after that and really great deck order on Omnitron's side.  All were around half health when Omni was finished off.

Twice we got lucky with Ruins playing villain cards, two krakens were great allies for us. RC wraith put one in play first round (II for belt and Eye) second one was on top as well, which was great considering the first round EPE.  Krakens took it from 11hp to 1.  Was very nice of them.

 

Again, it was about as perfect a match as I've seen.

I won the GI Bunker/AZ/RC Wraith.

Wow.  That really is some amazing luck!  Even regular cosmitron is a pain against these three (and, of course, GI Bunker's base power is wasted in this mode), but advanced…  I take off my imaginary hat to you.  :)
